description: This file defines the GLAccount entity class, representing a general ledger (GL) account in the accounting module of the project. It manages properties such as account hierarchy, code, name, type, usage, description, and relationships to parent and child accounts. The class includes methods for creating instances from JSON input, updating properties, generating hierarchy strings, and checking account types.

classes.name: GLAccount
classes.description: Entity class representing a general ledger account with hierarchical capabilities, properties such as code, name, type, usage, description, and relationships to parent and child accounts. It provides methods for JSON-based creation, property updates, hierarchy generation, and account type checks.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GLAccount instance from JSON input, optionally linking to a parent account and assigning a tag.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates properties of the GLAccount based on JSON command, tracking actual changes.

methods.name: generateHierarchy
methods.description: Generates and sets the hierarchy string for the account based on the parent account's hierarchy.

methods.name: hierarchyOf
methods.description: Constructs the hierarchy string for an account ID.

methods.name: isHeaderAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account is a header account based on usage.

methods.name: isDetailAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account is a detail account based on usage.
